d:
Dive into the emotions of “Maahi” from Raaz 2. Featuring Kangana Ranaut and Emraan Hashmi, this romantic track is composed by Toshi & Sharib Sabri and beautifully brings out themes of love and pain.
Credits:
Song Name - Maahi
Movie - RAAZ - The Mystery Continues
Singer - Toshi Shabri
Music - Sharib - Toshi
Lyrics - Sayeed Quadri
Director - Mohit Suri
